## Observations

1. Smoke source and spread: A dense white/blue smoke plume sits over the far stands. Over successive early frames it does not retreat behind the far roof. It spreads down and out over the front of the far stands and the edge of the pitch, i.e. back toward the camera side.

Using the penalty-box white lines and the large yellow banner as fixed world references, the specks move relative to the ground. If air flowed from the camera side toward the field, far-stand smoke would be carried farther away from the pitch, near-camera debris would recede (shrinking toward the middle of the frame), and foreground sheets would be pushed forward toward the field.
